note: Ana and Luis face the same direction from the hotel entrance. The mall is on their left and the pharmacy on their right. Ana is going to the mall; she confirms the side and finds the entrance. After arrival, a clearly marked second viewpoint introduces the station and the bank without silently reversing left and right. Fix the observer’s orientation before testing either side. Prefer photographed spatial context; a pointing person facing the learner can invert the intended left/right.
